prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1305; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the scene, the responding officer observed two passenger vehicles in the northbound lanes with visible front-end damage consistent with a low-speed head-on collision. Driver 1 was operating a sedan and stated that Driver 2, operating a pickup truck, crossed the centerline while attempting to pass a slower vehicle. Driver 2 disputed this account, stating that Driver 1 drifted into the adjacent lane shortly before impact. Both vehicles sustained moderate front bumper and hood damage, and both were drivable from the scene with assistance. A passenger riding in the sedan, identified in this report as Passenger, was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and was conscious and cooperative throughout. Emergency medical services evaluated Driver 1 on scene and recommended further evaluation, which Driver 1 declined at the time. No citations were issued pending review of traffic camera footage. Both drivers provided insurance information and exchanged contact details. Officer observations indicate weather was clear and the roadway was dry at the time of the collision.
